s1.desc: an empty space with a plain pale grey background

beats.text: Pax lies on his belly, cheek propped on one flipper, scrolling with the other on {ifin} lying on the floor
Pax blinks slowly, his head still resting on his flipper
Pax keeps scrolling the phone with his flipper, gazing down at the screen

spans.notes: plain background (motion: no fit); judged locked by compare 0/57: Pax's floor shadow and body edges overlap, his size and place constant (blue extent x0.23-0.71, y0.45-0.63 every 4th frame). Its tiny screen shows other people's posts: a green-and-red character f0-15, then a black-and-white penguin in a red scarf f16-55 (full-res crops f20, f40): not a lead. Ends at f56, when the next post (the blue penguin seen in the insert) starts scrolling onto the screen. Pax lies down: ~20% of the height but half the width, so medium wide

phone-screen insert: the iFin (tuft on top) fills the picture showing a social feed, Pax's flipper tapping in from the left. Post 1 is a Pax-like blue penguin in a red bandana and navy overalls (double-tap heart pops f76), then it scrolls to Polly holding a bouquet f88-98. Also lead_copy; in-world UI text

back to Pax lying on the floor (squeezed-shut eyes f99-102, heart eyes f103-133, chin on flipper), but the floor phone's screen shows the Polly-with-bouquet post (a pink penguin, recognisable at full res f110, f120) until f136; from f137 the screen shows a big heart instead

beats.text: Polly stands holding {ifin} to her cheek with her eyes squeezed shut and her face covered in little coral hearts as a heart floats up
Polly opens one eye for a moment, then squeezes both shut again, hugging the phone to her cheek
Polly sways and swings a flipper out to the side with one eye open, still clutching the phone
Polly hops up into the air and tips over backward
Polly lies on her back with her feet in the air, rocking gently as she clutches the phone to her face
